label: JD Wetherspoon allergens/nutrition API (per venue food menu)
notes: allergens.jdwetherspoon.com is a Vite SPA; its bundle /assets/index-*.js holds the config {apiPath:'https://ca.jdw-apps.net', foodPath:'api/allergens/v0.1/jdw/venues/{pubId}/food'} and a static bearer key '1|SFS9MMnn5deflq0BMcUTSijwSMBB4mc7NSG2rOhqb2765466' sent as Authorization: Bearer. Venue 90 returns the full national food menu; each record has calories, protein, fat, saturated_fat, carbohydrates, sugar, fibre, salt, allergens, vegetarians, vegans. Companion endpoints: /food-categories, /drinks, /drink-categories. Venue ids that carry no menu return an empty data array, so pick a venue with a full menu.
